errors.text_span: Етикетите на оста Y са разположени на интервали от 2000 EUR.
errors.evidence: The description states that the Y-axis labels are at intervals of 2000 EUR, but the image shows labels at intervals of 5000 (0, 5000, 10000, 15000, 20000, 25000).
The description states the line ends at a Y-value of 19400 in 2019. However, the chart shows the line ending at a value clearly above the 20000 gridline, approximately at 21500.
